title: WATCH How Jesus Will Fix It For You: God Will Work It Out (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: imagine the Peace of casting all your worries on God and simply saying Fix It Jesus think of a bustling street with honking cars busy footsteps and then knits did all a gentle whisper that says trust in him it's a whisper that provides peace and strength even in the chaos and that's what God wants to remind you of today trust in him he will fix it for you we're also going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God for divine

intervention and to bless you in the name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer as I often remind you our God is bigger than any problem we face he can make a way where there seem to be no way that's just the reality he knows how to fix whatever it is that needs fixing that's the God we serve as Genesis 18 verse 14 States is anything too hard for the Lord

now let us explore the powerful reassurance that God is always ready and willing to work wonders in our lives we should trust God at all times even when things seem out of our control let us take a look at 10 important truths that you should know as you seek to let God turn your situation around number one God will take you from Brokenness to wholeness life can sometimes shatter us leaving us feeling lost and broken but in those moments of deep

hurt and despair God's love shines the brightest it's like when a vase breaks and then it's carefully put back together the repaired vase becomes even more valuable because of its history and the care taken to mend it Psalm 34 Verse 18 says the Lord is near to those who have a broken heart and saves such as have a contrite spirit John 4 also tells us about the woman at the well she was shunned by others because of her past but Jesus

approached her offering living water and a chance for a fresh start just as he did with her jesus takes out broken pieces and puts them back together making us whole and renewed every scar every tear becomes a testament to his healing power and boundless love remember God will take you from Brokenness to wholeness trust him to do what he does best number two Embrace God's peace as we know it life can sometimes feel like a big scary storm big problems can

make us feel like we're being tossed around by giant waves but even in those moments God offers us a special kind of peace this isn't just regular calmness but a deep feeling of comfort that only he can give the Bible mentions in Philippians 4 verse 7. and the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and Minds through Christ Jesus a beautiful illustration of this Divine peace is seen in Daniel chapter 6 when Daniel was thrown into the

lion's den because of his faithfulness to God in a situation where anyone would be consumed by fear Daniel remained calm trusting in the Lord miraculously God closed the mouths of the Lions keeping Daniel safe like that when we asked Jesus to help he fills our hearts with peace making us feel safe even when things around us are chaotic number three God is our divine architect have you ever thought about the way an architect plans a building before even one brick is

laid there's a blueprint similarly God has a master design for each of Our Lives in Jeremiah 29 verse 11 the Bible tells us for I know the plans I have for you declares the Lord plans to prosper you and not to harm you plans to give you hope and a future this assures us that even when life feels messy God has a purpose think about Joseph's life sold by his brothers wrongly accused and imprisoned his life seemed like chaos yet in

the end every event aligned to place him as the second in command in Egypt preserving many lives during a famine we can find this story in Genesis 50 verse 20 so no matter how chaotic our lives may appear we can trust that God our divine architect is working behind the scenes on our behalf number four embrace the power of Faith Life can sometimes feel like being in a boat during a fierce storm waves crash around us and the wind howls it's

during these times that our faith becomes the anchor in Matthew 8 verse 26 Jesus said to his disciples during a storm why are you fearful owe you of little faith then he arose and rebuked the winds and the sea and there was a great calm this shows that even in the midst of life's fiercest storms faith in Jesus can bring peace throughout the scriptures we see numerous instances where Faith was the defining factor in witnessing the miraculous the Bible also reminds

us in Hebrews 11 verse 1. now faith is the substance of things hoped for the evidence of things not seen this verse teaches us that even when our surroundings are chaotic and unpredictable it's our unwavering faith in Jesus that becomes our anchor by holding on to this Faith even when everything feels out of control we open ourselves up to the miraculous interventions and blessings that God has prepared for those who believe so even when everything feels out of control holding on

to our faith in Jesus and believing that he will fix it allows us to witness the miraculous in our lives number five learn lessons from the wilderness the Bible is filled with stories that show how God supports and leads his people especially during hard times one of the most powerful examples is the Journey of Moses and the Israelites in the desert consider that for 40 long years they wandered in the wilderness a place with very little food and water yeah God

always ensured they had what they needed he sent down Manna From Heaven for them to eat and made sure they had water even in the driest places as it's mentioned in Exodus 16 verse 35 and the children of Israel ate Manna 40 years until they came to an inhabited land they ate Manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan this story reminds us that even when things look Bleak and challenging God is always there guiding us and

giving us what we need to keep going so even if you don't see how things could possibly turn around in your life keep the faith keep trusting God he sees the end from the beginning and remember nothing is impossible with God number six endure the Refiner's Fire challenges in life can often feel like we're being put through a fire tested and tried at every turn but there's a purpose to these challenges I can testify to that it's just that you often

won't see the purpose until the trial is passed just as gold is put through fire to get rid of any impurities and make it pure our difficulties and trials sometimes help to refine and strengthen our character the Bible puts it beautifully in Zechariah 13 verse 9 I will bring the one-third through the fire will refine them as silver is refined and test them as gold is tested they will call on my name and I will answer them I will say this

is my people and each one will say the Lord is my God so every time we Face a challenge it's an opportunity to grow stronger in our faith and come closer to God it's a process of purification that reminds us of our purpose and God's never-ending love and support God didn't promise US a life free of difficulties and trials but he promised that he would be with us every step of the way guiding supporting and giving us the strength to overcome

number seven surrender and let go when we talk about surrendering it doesn't mean quitting instead it means putting our trust in God and letting him lead the way it's like being on a boat in the middle of a vast ocean instead of anxiously trying to paddle on our own we trust the captain in this case we trust God to navigate the waters and lead us safely to shore the Bible tells us in Proverbs 3 verse 5 to 6 trust in the

Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding in all your ways acknowledge Him and He Shall direct your paths in Genesis 22 verses 1 to 14. we see the story of Abraham when God asked him to sacrifice his only son Isaac Abraham didn't understand why but he was ready to do it he surrendered his will to God but in the end God provided a ram to sacrifice instead showing that when we let go and trust him he

always provides a way surrendering means letting Jesus fix it without letting our human fears and doubts get in the way let go and let God number eight God's timing is not ours we often want things to happen right away if we're facing a problem we want it fixed immediately but God has his own timing and it's always perfect think of it like planting a seed we can't rush it to grow it needs its own time to turn into a beautiful plant

the Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3 verse 1. to everything there is a season a time for every purpose under heaven Remember The Story of Lazarus in John 11 verses 1 to 44 when Jesus heard Lazarus was sick he didn't rush immediately by the time Jesus arrived Lazarus had died but Jesus knew the perfect timing and raised Lazarus from the dead this showed everyone that God's timing even if different from ours brings about the most miraculous results so when we're impatient we

should remember that God knows the best time to act for our good all we need to do is trust him number nine be aware of unseen Miracles God's wonders aren't always big and flashy sometimes they're quiet gentle nudges that work in the background imagine a seed growing under the soil even though we can't see it right away with time a strong plant emerges in the same way God often Works within us nurturing and guiding our hearts and souls even when we

aren't aware the Bible tells us in Isaiah 55. verses 8 to 9. for my thoughts are not your thoughts nor are your ways my ways says the Lord for as the heavens are higher than the Earth so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts let's look at the story of Ruth after losing her husband she could have felt that all was lost but God was working behind the scenes leading her to a new family and

blessing her with a significant lineage the real miracles sometimes are those subtle changes in our mindset making us more patient loving and understanding and number 10 there is the ultimate promise life has its ups and downs but there's one promise from God that stands out above all it's the story of Jesus dying on the cross and then coming back to life this isn't just a story about something that happened a long time ago it's a reminder of God's power and love

Romans 8 verse 11 says but if the spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you the same power that brought Jesus back to life is with us today think about it if Jesus could be death the biggest enemy then there's nothing in our lives he can't help with every challenge every sadness Jesus can turn it around

for something good showing his amazing love and Power in our journey through life we are often met with challenges uncertainties and moments of despair but in the face of all these we have a steadfast anchor in Jesus when we cast our burdens on God and ask for divine intervention it's a declaration of our unwavering trust in the one who created the universe and yet cares deeply about every intricate detail of Our Lives as we've explored today God doesn't just see our

struggles he actively Works behind the scenes often in ways we might not immediately recognize to bring about healing peace and Redemption it's essential to remember that the same power that raised Jesus from the dead is available to us today eager to transform our circumstances for our good and His glory so the next time you're faced with a mountain that seems too high or a valley too deep utter those three simple words with faith Fix It Jesus and then watch with hope

and expectation as God unfolds his miraculous plan reminding us once again that he is forever in control working everything out for our benefit now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray you are gracious and loving God Heavenly Father Lord God Almighty king of all kings and Lord of all Lords

with all that is within me I praise your Holy Name father I come before you with a heart full of gratitude and praise Lord I am thankful that every challenge I face you are there to fix it I place every uncertainty every Challenge and every sorrow that I face before you knowing that you are working it out for my good in the name of Jesus I rebuke every negative Force every obstacle and every hindrance trying to affect my faith I declare

that no weapon formed against me shall prosper and every tongue that rises against me in judgment shall be condemned I declare that everything is working for me and not against me I ask you Lord to deliver me from all evil and protect me in my comings and goings God of Miracles I call upon your divine intervention in every area of my life I ask for your guidance when I'm lost restoration when I'm broken Lord I ask for your Abundant Blessings in

my life may you provide for me wherever I experience lack I ask you to strengthen me wherever I am weak I ask that you increase my faith wherever I doubt I declare healing over my body mind and soul in the name of Jesus father let your will and your plan Prevail in all I do I lift up my loved ones to you Lord may you bless their lives with your peace and love and goodness Lord as I say this prayer together

with everyone listening I am grateful for All Hearts opening to you right now I pray that each person will feel and experience your undeniable presence May every weary heart find rest in you merciful father I pray that those seeking answers will receive them with Divine Clarity I am grateful Lord that you are moving mightily working wonders in our lives according to your perfect will I give thanks for your Amazing Grace endless mercies and everlasting love I thank you for your promise

to always be with us Lord may your Holy Spirit give us comfort and help us in our moments of need thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you

can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory

also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you are not prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring comfort healing and guidance in accordance
with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
